players.product: precision optical components for 800G / 1.6T modules (CWDM filters, aspheric lenses, Z-block) and OCS passives (large-size YVO4 crystals, 2D collimator arrays)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, meetings 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-22): as an upstream optoelectronic component supplier its products fit MEMS, liquid-crystal and piezo-ceramic OCS routes; following the designs of major domestic and overseas OCS system makers it can supply collimators, 2D collimator arrays, large-size pure YVO4 crystals, lenses, prisms and mirrors. Some products for the liquid-crystal route are already in volume production, and components for the MEMS and piezo-ceramic routes are planned to reach mass production within the year.
quarterly_data.figure: MEMS / piezo-ceramic OCS components: mass production planned within the year

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): products developed and in validation for CPO are FAU optical connection assemblies for connecting CPO optical engines, and integrated lenses (cylindrical, aspheric-cylindrical, freeform) for coupling the CW laser to polarization-maintaining fiber in ELS external light-source modules; silicon lenses (built on its micro-nano optics platform) are in the validation stage. Management: NPO has some synergy with pluggable modules in passive optical component supply, and its core technology is reusable across optical-communication routes.

Management (IR record): the Hefei YVO4 crystal project has completed its phase-one and phase-two expansions and the lines run at full load; the Thailand plant is built and being brought into production; at the Zhengzhou plant some lines are in use and entering the start of volume production. New lines are brought up in stages according to customer validation and orders, and actual capacity release depends on validation, yield, product mix and customer demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Hefei YVO4 lines at full load

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): AI-driven R&D, expansion and line build-out in optical communications is lifting demand for optical test instruments; subsidiaries GouMax and Gaomai Optical Communication cooperate on test-instrument R&D, production and markets; orders on hand are full and, as capacity is released, overall delivery capacity this year is expected to rise substantially versus last year.

Management (IR record): the semiconductor-equipment optics business (high-end optical modules and precision optical components) keeps growing and has become an important growth source beyond optical communications; the company will expand capacity in line with customer validation, orders and deliveries.
